moltres-heat-wave.name: Heat Wave
moltres-heat-wave.description: Bond skill: a scorching wind up to 2 hexes away (Power 85, Sp. Atk), 1-hex area; Burns 1 turn.

moltres-sky-attack.name: Sky Attack
moltres-sky-attack.description: Bond skill: wreathed in flame, it plunges from the sky into a foe (Power 110, Attack).

moltres-roost.name: Roost
moltres-roost.description: Bond skill: lands to rest its wings and heals 40 HP.

moltres-flame-body.name: Flame Body
moltres-flame-body.description: Its damaging hits on adjacent foes Burn them for 1 turn.

moltres-sunlit-plumage.name: Sunlit Plumage
moltres-sunlit-plumage.description: Its Fire moves deal 15% more damage.

moltres-agility.name: Agility
moltres-agility.description: New skill: relaxes its body to move faster and becomes Hasted for 2 turns.

moltres-air-slash.name: Air Slash
moltres-air-slash.description: New skill: a blade of air at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 60).

moltres-rebirth-flame.name: Rebirth Flame
moltres-rebirth-flame.description: Its fire flares up anew: heals 15% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

moltres-smoldering-mantle.name: Smoldering Mantle
moltres-smoldering-mantle.description: Its burning plumage deals 6 damage to foes that hit it from an adjacent hex.

moltres-incinerate.name: Incinerate
moltres-incinerate.description: New skill: sprays fire over a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 60).

moltres-steel-wing.name: Steel Wing
moltres-steel-wing.description: New skill: strikes with wings hard as steel (Power 70).

moltres-searing-trail.name: Searing Trail
moltres-searing-trail.description: Its free strikes on foes breaking away deal 25% more damage.

moltres-hurricane.name: Hurricane
moltres-hurricane.description: New skill: a fiery gale at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 90).

moltres-fly.name: Fly
moltres-fly.description: New skill: soars up and swoops on a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 80), engaging it.

moltres-cinder-hunt.name: Cinder Hunt
moltres-cinder-hunt.description: Deals 20% more damage to Burned foes.

moltres-sky-dancer.name: Sky Dancer
moltres-sky-dancer.description: Wheels away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

moltres-overheat.name: Overheat
moltres-overheat.description: New skill: an all-out blast of fire at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 100).

moltres-giga-impact.name: Giga Impact
moltres-giga-impact.description: New skill: crashes into a foe with all its might (Power 100), knocking it back 1 hex.

moltres-rekindle.name: Rekindle
moltres-rekindle.description: When it faints, its flame passes on: the team gains 2 Bond.

moltres-heat-mirage.name: Heat Mirage
moltres-heat-mirage.description: Shimmering heat hides it: takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

moltres-phoenix-rebirth.name: Phoenix Rebirth
moltres-phoenix-rebirth.description: Capstone. Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP; its Fire moves deal 25% more below half HP.

moltres-sun-incarnate.name: Sun Incarnate
moltres-sun-incarnate.description: Capstone. Its statuses last 1 turn longer; deals 15% more damage to statused foes.

moltres-blazing-wings.name: Blazing Wings
moltres-blazing-wings.description: Its Flying moves deal 15% more damage.
